summary: April 29, 2026: FOMC held rates at 3.5%-3.75% in 8-4 split vote. Dissenter Miran wanted 25bp cut; Hammack/Kashkari/Logan opposed easing bias language. Likely Powell's final meeting as chair. Inflation elevated partly due to energy price surge.
